panels.title: Custom events — count + last seen
panels.description: First stop after any deploy that touches instrumentation. An event in the registry with 0 rows here is not 'unused' — it is very likely broken. This panel is how the app-load bug (0 events against 731 route-enters) was found on 2026-09-10.

targets.rawSql:
select event_name, count(*) as events, count(distinct session_id) as sessions, max(created_at) as last_seen
from website_event
where website_id = '$site' and event_type = 2 and $__timeFilter(created_at)
group by 1
order by events desc;

panels.title: Exploration rate — /explore sessions that interacted
panels.description: Of the sessions that opened /explore, how many actually clicked a body/marker. The product question: does the explorer provoke interaction, or do people just look at it?

panels.title: Exploration depth — sessions reaching each scale shell
panels.description: explore-depth is deduped per level per page-load, so this counts people, not zooms. The drop-off from solar-system outward is the 'do they leave the opening view' signal.

targets.rawSql:
select d.string_value as level, count(distinct e.session_id) as sessions
from website_event e
join event_data d on d.website_event_id = e.event_id and d.data_key = 'level'
where e.website_id = '$site' and e.event_name = 'explore-depth' and $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
group by 1
order by array_position(array['solar-system','neighborhood','milky-way','local-group','local-sheet','virgo','laniakea','cosmic-web'], d.string_value);

panels.title: Flight progression — sessions reaching each /fly act
panels.description: One event name per act (fly-ascent … fly-recovery) so Umami's own Funnel report can step through them; this panel is the same data as a bar chart. Deduped per mission+act, so scrubbing does not inflate it.

targets.rawSql:
select replace(event_name, 'fly-', '') as act, count(distinct session_id) as sessions
from website_event
where website_id = '$site'
  and event_name in ('fly-ascent','fly-coast','fly-cruise','fly-descent','fly-recovery')
  and $__timeFilter(created_at)
group by 1
order by array_position(array['ascent','coast','cruise','descent','recovery'], replace(event_name, 'fly-', ''));

panels.title: Exploration → learning: where science readers came from
panels.description: science-section-view.source is the route the visitor came FROM. '(cold entry)' means search or a direct link — an organic landing page rather than a journey destination.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(d.string_value, '(cold entry)') as came_from, count(*) as section_views
from website_event e
left join event_data d on d.website_event_id = e.event_id and d.data_key = 'source'
where e.website_id = '$site' and e.event_name = 'science-section-view' and $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
group by 1
order by section_views desc;

panels.title: Learning → experimentation: science-to-app destinations
panels.description: Where visitors go when they leave explanatory content for an interactive tool. The other half of the loop.

targets.rawSql:
select d.string_value as destination, count(*) as n
from website_event e
join event_data d on d.website_event_id = e.event_id and d.data_key = 'destination'
where e.website_id = '$site' and e.event_name = 'science-to-app' and $__timeFilter(e.created_at)
group by 1
order by n desc;

panels.title: Planner engagement — ran vs selected a window
panels.description: Before plan-run/plan-window-select existed, /plan emitted only two filter-change events and it was impossible to tell whether the planner was ever USED. trigger='initial' is everyone who landed; 'destination-change' is deliberate comparison.

targets.rawSql:
select
  count(distinct case when event_name = 'plan-run' then session_id end) as ran,
  count(distinct case when event_name = 'plan-window-select' then session_id end) as selected_window,
  count(*) filter (where event_name = 'plan-window-select') as window_picks
from website_event
where website_id = '$site'
  and event_name in ('plan-run','plan-window-select')
  and $__timeFilter(created_at);

panels.title: Engaged Learning Sessions
panels.description: Sessions containing BOTH interaction (item-click / explore-depth / plan-run / fly-<act>) and learning (science-section-view / science-to-app). Deliberately a count of sessions, not events. Reach and single-article readership stay meaningful separately — not every visit has to become this.

targets.rawSql:
with per_session as (
  select session_id,
    bool_or(event_name in ('item-click','explore-depth','plan-run','fly-ascent','fly-coast','fly-cruise','fly-descent','fly-recovery')) as interacted,
    bool_or(event_name in ('science-section-view','science-to-app')) as learned
  from website_event
  where website_id = '$site' and event_type = 2 and $__timeFilter(created_at)
  group by session_id
)
select count(*) filter (where interacted and learned) as "engaged learning sessions"
from per_session;
